title: WPSS/3152/2018 of SANDEEP KUMAR THAPALIYAL Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No. 3152 of 2018
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Navnish Negi, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. N.P. Shah, Standing Counsel for the
State/respondents.
The Uttarakhand Technical Education Board
vide its publication 09.02.2014 has organized a
competitive examination for selection of Group-C
posts, which were the posts lying outside the
purview of Public Service Commission and they
were lying vacant in different departments of the
State of Uttarakhand including UREDA i.e.
Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development
Agency.
The petitioner contends that since he was
eligible and holding the qualification prescribed for
the said post, he extended his candidature and he
participated in the selection process as against the
three vacant posts of Technical Assistant published
through the Technical Board. The selection process
was concluded on 18.06.2017 but despite of having
been selected and having succeeded in the
examination as would be apparent from the result
declared he was called upon before the respondent to
appear for verification of the documents. He
undertook the said process and appeared before the
authority for verification of the documents.
His grievance is despite of culmination of
those proceedings he has not been given the
appointment. Raising his grievance, he has
submitted his representation before the respondent
no. 1, what he contends that the reason which has
been reflected in the information, which he has
reiterated is that the State, by virtue of an order no.
706/I/2017-03/03/2017 T.C. dated 17th October,
2017 had frozen the seats on account of the
enforcement of the revised pay scale granted to the

employees. It is the communication dated
22.11.2017, which has been put to challenge before
this Court.
At this stage, this Court is not inclined to
scrutinize the veracity of the order dated 17th
October, 2017, which constituted an impediment in
granting appointment to the petitioner in pursuance
of the selection held on 18.06.2017.
In that eventuality, this Writ Petition is being
disposed of with a direction to consider and decide
the representation of the petitioner dated 01.05.2018
within the specified time frame i.e. within six weeks
from service of the certified copy of this order.
Subject to the above observations, this Writ
Petition stands disposed of.
